Lawn Mowing Blacktown & Western Sydney — Regular, Reliable, Insured

Fortnightly or monthly cuts with edges trimmed, paths blown and clippings removed. Ride-on mowing for larger blocks.

Get a Free Quote 0452 586 355

Looking for lawn mowing in Blacktown that actually turns up? Greater Sydney Landscapes runs regular mowing rounds across Blacktown, Toongabbie, Seven Hills, Parramatta and The Hills from our base at 56 Ballandella Rd, Toongabbie. You pick the schedule, we keep to it, and your lawn stays cut, edged and tidy without you having to chase anyone.

Regular lawn mowing services in Blacktown and surrounds

Most of our Blacktown lawn mowing customers are on a fortnightly round through spring and summer, dropping back to three-weekly or monthly in the cooler months when growth slows. Every visit includes the mow, the edges along paths and garden beds, whipper-snipping around fences and posts, and a blow-down of the hard surfaces so you are not walking clippings into the house. We bring our own equipment and fuel, and we take the green waste with us unless you would rather keep it for mulch.

Ride-on mowing for larger blocks and acreage

Got a big backyard, a corner block or acreage out towards Dural, Kenthurst or The Hills? We run ride-on mowers for properties over about 800 square metres, which means the job is done in a fraction of the time and priced accordingly. Ride-on mowing suits paddocks, nature strips, strata common areas, church grounds and sports fields as well as rural-residential blocks. We finish the edges and tight corners with a push mower and whipper-snipper so the whole property looks the same, not just the open ground.

Why Blacktown and Western Sydney homeowners choose us

We are a small local crew, so the people who quote your lawn are the people who mow it. We are fully insured, we text before we arrive, and we send one simple invoice at the end of each visit or each month, whichever you prefer. If the lawn is looking tired, we can add fertilising and weed spraying from our lawn care service so it is green again, not just short.

Ride-On Mowing

Big blocks, acreage, paddocks and strata grounds mown fast with ride-on equipment. Ask about it when you request your lawn mowing quote.

Lawn Mowing FAQs

How often should I have my lawn mowed in Blacktown?

Fortnightly through spring and summer keeps most Sydney lawns healthy and tidy. In autumn and winter three-weekly or monthly is usually enough. We will suggest a schedule when we quote and adjust it through the year.

Do you take the grass clippings away?

Yes. Green waste removal is included in our lawn mowing price. If you would prefer to keep clippings for your compost or mulch, just let us know.

Do you mow nature strips and front verges?

We do. Most customers have us mow the nature strip as part of the regular visit so the whole frontage looks the same.

Can you mow a large block or acreage?

Yes. We run ride-on mowers for blocks over roughly 800 square metres, including acreage properties in Dural, The Hills and Hornsby. We finish edges and tight spots with a push mower.
